facts.fact: Porky 在地下室睡觉做梦：梦里他一样胖却轻得能飞，看见海里一个同龄裸体女孩（Giulia），没敢下去。
facts.anchor: In Dream, Porky is no less fat, but much lighter, light enough to fly.

facts.fact: 口吃的 Filippo 在梦里不必再念满是小舌音的绕口令，而是在森林里被袭击后反手打回去，边打边笑。
facts.anchor: He no longer has to stand at the front of the class reciting “Susie’s sewing stockings for soldiers.”

facts.fact: 孩子们用木剑对打、越打越乐；叙述者说父母们「已经有过自己的时代，放弃惊奇去活在世上」，而世界未必同意他们。
facts.anchor: Their parents can never understand, because they’ve had their time, and given up on wonder to live in the world.

facts.fact: Wedge（Luca）被送进 Santa Lucia 私人诊所——19 世纪由富有的虔诚神秘学家 Girolamo Venturi 创办，主张药物手术与祈祷并用。
facts.anchor: It’s called the Santa Lucia Clinic and it was founded in the 19th century by Girolamo Venturi, the famous, wealthy, and pious occultist.

facts.fact: Augusto Dal Mare 先给 Luca 父亲打电话要求见孩子，随后跛着脚、拄银柄木杖走进诊所（护士笑他像 House）。
facts.anchor: Dal Mare enters the clinic limping slightly, as injury has forced him to do for the last fourteen years.

facts.fact: Dal Mare 单独审问 Luca 那晚细节（男人还是女人、年龄、声音），Luca 说「他们的脚是光的」，Dal Mare 立刻追问「在沥青路上？」。
Dal Mare 追问「你和朋友做了什么」，Luca 只说拿了喷漆；Dal Mare 临走警告「别再对我撒谎」，Luca 觉得那根杖柄像钩子。
facts.anchor: “Never lie to me again,” he warns, before walking out.

facts.fact: 第二节：Wendy 在 Via Veneto 见经纪人 Aldo Miglio——他要她周日免费演出、砍掉魔术、把怪物改成南方穷人；Wendy 最后让步「那就谈周日吧」。
